== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Romas 'Lock' Navander (Japanese)|Romas 'Lock' Navander]] from [[Hoth (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/showcase/miscellaneous/1998-decipher-star-wars-ccg-japanese-hoth-robert-john/imagegallery/32924 Robert John's Japanese Hoth PSA showcase], [https://d1htnxwo4o0jhw.cloudfront.net/cert/156433106/xhwALYrid02hqbY94iF38w.jpg source photograph], PSA certificate 89232344.

Crop rectangle <code>(145, 620, 1290, 2220)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>ee7c934d8f6952137863e7fcee19266aea455ba1ee35d2de1a0c8118951d666d</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1998.
